name: Citizenship by Descent

requirement_groups.name: Both parents Kazakhstani citizens (automatic, any birth country)

requirements.blocker_text: A child is a citizen of Kazakhstan by descent if both parents were Kazakhstani citizens at the time of the child's birth, regardless of the child's country of birth (Citizenship Law, Article 11).

requirement_groups.name: One parent a citizen (conditional on birth location or parental residence)

requirements.blocker_text: Where only one parent is a Kazakhstani citizen (the other being a foreign national or stateless), the child acquires citizenship if born in Kazakhstan, OR if the parents maintain permanent residence in Kazakhstan regardless of birth country (Article 12) -- applied equally regardless of which parent holds Kazakhstani citizenship.

evidence_required.document: Proof of parental permanent residence in Kazakhstan (one-parent-citizen track, if born abroad)

sources.title: Electronic Government of the Republic of Kazakhstan (egov.kz) -- official summary of citizenship-by-descent rules: automatic citizenship when both parents are Kazakhstani citizens regardless of birth country, and conditional citizenship (birth in Kazakhstan or parents' permanent residence there) when only one parent is a citizen

notes: NEW COUNTRY BUILD (Kazakhstan). STATUS: PUBLISHED -- direct e-government sourcing, tier 1, cross-referenced against an NGO-hosted (ecoi.net, tier 2) English translation of the underlying 1991 Citizenship Law (as amended 2013) confirming Articles 11-12 apply without any paternal/maternal distinction. GENUINE POSITIVE FINDING: descent citizenship is fully gender-neutral on its face, with no different treatment based on which parent holds Kazakhstani citizenship -- joining Kenya, Pakistan, India, Tunisia, and Tanzania in this dataset as having a reformed, equal descent rule, in contrast to Iran's paternal-default and Lebanon's paternal-only systems built earlier in this dataset. dual_citizenship_allowed set false: Kazakhstan's citizenship law contains an explicit, strict dual-citizenship ban -- 'a citizen of the Republic of Kazakhstan is not recognized as a citizen of another country' -- with a genuinely distinctive enforcement mechanism (Article 21(5)) requiring anyone who acquires a foreign citizenship to report it and surrender their Kazakhstani passport/ID within 3 working days, or lose citizenship automatically.
